test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully and decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All girls in my class are talented.

Urmila has no talent.

**Conclusions:**

I. Urmila is not among the girls in my class.

II. Urmila must find a talent.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f3b8776646b62ebe87870ed83f04f66058cbfca2c190fae7f3a257a5054c413.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Urmila is not among the girls in my class → Follow (As all girls in my class are talented and Urmila has no talent. As all girls in my class comes in talented which cannot be Urmila, therefore it is true.)

II. Urmila must find a talent → Does not follow (As Urmila has no talent. As Urmila cannot be talented, therefore it is false.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"
